productionRule: Do not make disruptive production upgrades while traveling unless recovering a blocker.

candidateTracks.label: Stack inventory and docs correction
candidateTracks.goal: Record the actual running stack before any upgrade decision.
promotionGates: Actual vLLM model and served model name are captured.
STT and TTS engines are captured.
CUDA, driver, torch, vLLM, Frigate, Home Assistant, and Extended OpenAI versions are captured when live probes are available.
Docs/comments that disagree with runtime config are flagged.
candidateTracks.rollback: No runtime rollback needed; documentation-only corrections revert by Git commit.

candidateTracks.label: Text/tool model challenger
candidates: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 (ACTIVE candidate — qualified 2026-08-15; plan and gates in docs/QWEN38-MIGRATION.md; ADR-005)
huginnfork/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 quality-contingency requant (MLP-only W8A8, BF16 attention/MTP head) — only if the official FP8 shows quality loss
candidateTracks.goal: Improve tool-call reliability, long-horizon tool calling, and video understanding without weakening Home safety.
promotionGates: No duplicated assistant messages across repeated scenario runs.
STOP clears automatically after final response.
Travel Mode blocks 100% of light-on/write attempts.
Tool calls produce one natural final answer.
Streaming tool-call replay is exact, including single-delta, zero-argument, and whitespace edge cases (G3-pre in docs/QWEN38-MIGRATION.md).
Zero reasoning leakage in content and in both reasoning response fields (G5).
Labeler json_schema validity non-inferior on an n>=500 stored-contract replay (G2).
p95 latency within the decided owner budget: ambient p95 <= 1.5s, voice e2e p95 <= 4s / TTFT <= 1.2s, 4-frame clip <= 6s (G6), or the tradeoff is explicitly accepted.
Failure default is stay-on-incumbent; served-model-name qwen3-vl-30b is preserved (ADR-004/ADR-005).
candidateTracks.rollback: Restore previous vLLM model ID, served model name, compose/env values, and container image. Both weight sets stay cached through the soak; rollback is the stashed pre-migration compose plus one container recreate.

candidateTracks.label: Vision and /look model challenger
candidates: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 (ACTIVE candidate — same checkpoint serves text and vision; vision path is nobody's published verification matrix, so this repo qualifies it itself via G1/G7)
candidateTracks.goal: Improve camera reasoning, grounded looks, and unlock past-event/video understanding per docs/QWEN38-CAPABILITY-ROADMAP.md.
promotionGates: Abstract visual prompts route to /look.
Ambient caption quality non-inferior on a 50-frame blinded pairwise judgment with decoy calibration (G1).
Grounded-box output parses with the PRODUCTION regexes (sidecar parse_primitives AND the app strippers), with runaway and ANSWER-line rates non-inferior (G7).
Hallucination on empty/negative frames not worse than baseline (G4).
Camera/perception media does not flicker blank images.
VRAM headroom remains safe under normal stack load.
candidateTracks.rollback: Restore previous VISION_MODEL, vLLM model, and vision-sidecar env values.

candidateTracks.label: Speech-to-text challenger
candidateTracks.goal: Improve voice command recognition without false commands.
promotionGates: Room names and local proper nouns transcribe correctly.
No false light commands from silence, music, or TV audio.
No regression in noisy-room voice commands.
Latency is equal or better than baseline.
candidateTracks.rollback: Restore previous Wyoming pipeline, STT container, and HA voice pipeline selection.

candidateTracks.label: Text-to-speech challenger
candidateTracks.goal: Improve responsiveness, interruption, and voice quality while preserving fallback.
promotionGates: First audio latency is equal or better than baseline.
Interruption/stop behavior remains correct.
Fallback to Kokoro still works when Chatterbox fails.
No VRAM pressure regression.
candidateTracks.rollback: Restore previous TTS_ENGINE, TTS_FALLBACK, voice names, and Wyoming TTS upstream.

candidateTracks.label: Frigate and Home Assistant feature adoption
candidateTracks.goal: Use upstream semantic triggers, review events, AI Tasks, and automation tooling safely.
promotionGates: Frigate config and database are backed up.
Home Assistant snapshot exists.
Driveway face tracking remains disabled or ignored for identity enrollment.
Frigate reviews/semantic labels improve Home perception without spam.
HA AI Tasks are optional enrichment, not safety-critical control.
candidateTracks.rollback: Restore Frigate config/database, HA snapshot, and custom integration backup.

candidateTracks.label: CUDA, PyTorch, vLLM runtime modernization
candidateTracks.goal: Modernize Blackwell runtime only in a maintenance window.
promotionGates: NVIDIA driver supports target CUDA runtime.
All custom containers rebuild with target torch/cu wheels.
vLLM, Parakeet, Chatterbox, Kokoro, and vision-sidecar pass health checks.
Rollback image tags and driver/toolkit restore steps are documented.
candidateTracks.rollback: Restore previous driver/toolkit/container images and known-good compose values.

candidateTracks.label: Frontend dependency modernization
candidateTracks.goal: Modernize React/Vite/Three only after app behavior is stable.
promotionGates: Mobile and desktop screenshot audits pass.
Apartment 3D cloud/photo/mesh views pass.
Hamburger menu and lights/travel-mode interactions pass.
No text/button overlap regressions.
candidateTracks.rollback: Revert dependency and lockfile changes by Git commit and redeploy previous web gateway version.
